result: Updated Saves UI to consume BackupMetadata, display source/size/time/SHA-256, provide browser downloads, explicit confirmed restore POST payload, and owner-gated rename/delete/restore controls. Hardened rename/delete with compensating filesystem rollback/tombstone cleanup when metadata persistence fails.

evidence.outcome: Saves renders metadata objects and lifecycle controls; restore sends {confirm:true}; download uses opaque ID endpoint
Rename restores original filename if metadata update fails; delete uses tombstone and restores file if metadata deletion fails

next_slice.summary: Wire me.role into Saves invocation so owner controls are shown only to owners; add focused compensation/integrity tests if desired.

blockers: App still invokes <Saves action={action} /> without role={me?.role}, so owner controls are hidden for all users until invocation is wired.
